annual.label: 연간 전망
gaps: 연간 공시 전망과 동일 사업 범위 YTD가 확인될 때 잔여 수주·인도 계획으로 산출. 현재 전력기기 모델은 분기 모델.

logic.bm: Hitachi Energy (ex-ABB Power Grids): power transformers incl. large power and HVDC converter transformers (765 kV class for North America/India, Varennes is one of the largest HVDC transformer makers), shunt reactors, distribution transformers (single-phase padmount etc.), dry and traction transformers, bushings/insulation components; HVDC systems, GIS / dead-tank breakers / hybrid switchgear, FACTS (STATCOM, series compensation), grid automation & asset-management software. Company states 60+ transformer factories and service centers worldwide. Revenue here is in JPY as consolidated by Hitachi (strong USD/EUR translation effect).
logic.recognition: 제품 출하·고객 검수 또는 프로젝트 진행률의 회사 공시 기준을 대사. 수주액·수주잔고·수출통계는 매출과 별도.
logic.bridge: 이미 인식한 누적 매출 + 납기별 기초 수주잔고 전환 + 당기 수주 중 인도 가능한 물량. 생산능력·취소·검수·환율을 별도 가정.

profile.end_markets: Transmission & distribution utilities/TSOs (NA, Europe, India, China, Brazil), HVDC interconnectors & offshore-wind grid connections, renewables integration, data centers/AI loads, industry, railways (traction transformers).

existing facility, expansion under the 2025 US$1bn US plan (product not specified in release)
dead-tank breakers, gas-insulated & hybrid switchgear (not transformers)

plants.products: power transformers (US$200m+ expansion; exports incl. Saudi Arabia)
large power transformers AC & DC (HVDC), bushings; +~40% LPT capacity by autumn 2026

plants.products: power, dry distribution and traction transformers (Gujarat); components in Mysuru & Halol

profile.products: Hitachi Energy (ex-ABB Power Grids): power transformers incl. large power and HVDC converter transformers (765 kV class for North America/India, Varennes is one of the largest HVDC transformer makers), shunt reactors, distribution transformers (single-phase padmount etc.), dry and traction transformers, bushings/insulation components; HVDC systems, GIS / dead-tank breakers / hybrid switchgear, FACTS (STATCOM, series compensation), grid automation & asset-management software. structural_breaks.note: Hitachi Chemical deconsolidated from FY2020 (Hitachi consolidated revenue only).

Hitachi completed acquisition of 80.1% of ABB Power Grids → "Hitachi ABB Power Grids" consolidated from FY2020Q2 (Energy segment sub-line, Q1 FY2020 printed "-"). Segment history starts FY2020Q2; pre-acquisition history is in ABB (USD).

Hitachi moved Hitachi Energy (Standalone) line from Energy segment to new Green Energy & Mobility (GEM) segment; FY2021 comparatives printed unchanged (e.g. Q1 FY2021 264.6) → no break in the standalone line itself.
Hitachi Metals shares transferred (53.4%→0%), deconsolidated; Hitachi Construction Machinery also left consolidation during FY2022 (Hitachi lists Astemo, HCM, Metals as "deconsolidated business").
Hitachi Astemo became an equity-method affiliate (deconsolidated).
Railway Systems completed acquisition of Thales's railway signalling business (GTS) in May 2024 (Hitachi consolidated only).

GEM split into Energy and Mobility sectors. From FY2025 Hitachi prints JPY revenue/orders only for the "Power Grid(s)" BU (incl. Hitachi Energy); Hitachi Energy standalone is printed only in USD. Scope gap measured on FY2024 annual: Power Grid (recast) 2,417.1 vs Hitachi Energy (Standalone) 2,395.5 bn yen = +0.9%. FY2025 YoY computed against FY2024 standalone points therefore carries ~+0.9pp scope bias (company-printed like-for-like YoY: Q1 +11%, Q2 +29%, Q3 +34%, FY +24%).
